Assumption | Value

Down payment / closing | 20% / 3%
Mortgage | 30-yr fixed at 6.75%
Taxes / insurance / maintenance | 1.2% / $1,500 per yr / 1% per yr
Appreciation / selling cost | 3% per yr / 6% of sale price
Alternative return on cash | 5% per yr
